articles.title: Five years into AUKUS, what do we have to show for it? We’ve measured progress on three key metrics
articles.summary: The AUKUS trilateral security partnership between the US, UK, and Australia marks its fifth anniversary this week. Announced by then-leaders Biden, Johnson, and Morrison, AUKUS focuses on enhancing security cooperation and advanced technology sharing, including nuclear-powered submarines. This alliance is crucial for strengthening defence capabilities and strategic stability, particularly in the Indo-Pacific region, solidifying a key geopolitical pact.
